curriculumProbeCostNotice: This sends one page of text to the model twice and may incur model usage charges. It does not change the course catalog.
curriculumProbeNotExtraction: This checks the connection, not whether course extraction succeeded.
curriculumRulesReadOnly: Verified curriculum rules are read-only; you can change your own progress.
curriculumProgressClearDescription: This deletes pass/fail statuses for this curriculum on this device. The shared curriculum is unchanged.
curriculumProgressClearFailed: Could not clear course progress. Try again.
curriculumProgressSaveFailed: Course progress was not saved. Check the course service and try again.
curriculumCreditsUnknown: Graduation credit requirement is not yet verified in the structured catalog.
curriculumGraphUnavailable: The course preview is not available yet
curriculumGraphMayTakeTime: The source is stored. Preview generation may take up to a minute; suggested order is not a formal prerequisite.
curriculumImportFailed: Curriculum import failed. No course graph was generated.
curriculumRecommendedSequenceLegend: {{count}} dashed links show suggested course order, not formal prerequisites.
curriculumSuggestedPrerequisitesHint: Consider completing these courses first. This order was recognized from the flowchart and is not a formal enrollment restriction.
curriculumStoredDescription: The source file is stored. Course extraction and graph generation have not run yet.
curriculumUploadDescription: Select a curriculum PDF to identify its metadata, store it in the knowledge base, and preview its course graph automatically.
curriculumSupportedFormats: Text-based PDF; click to choose a file
